messages:
karen.ops: @here seeing a big spike of 502/ backend errors hitting /v1/generate in us-west1 since 12:03 UTC. customer-facing errors increasing, some Dedicated pools showing timeouts. :rotating_light:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — High Error Rate: /v1/generate (us-west1). Pager duty triggered (PD#INC-9821). Runbook: https://runbook.internal/incidents/high-502s
lee.oncall: I'm on it. grabbing logs now, will check LB health and instance metrics. tagging @alex.sre for infra.
alex.sre: thanks. initial look — upstream (GCP internal load balancer) shows sporadic 5xx on 3/6 backends. kernel-level conn resets on two boxes. holding on ssh to host-uw-13.
sam.eng: copying relevant error snippet:
```
2026-03-15T12:04:07Z ERROR handler.go:184 request_id=... upstream: connection reset by peer
2026-03-15T12:04:08Z WARN router.go:92 retrying request
```
looks like short window of upstream failures, correlates with time of drop in successful tokens.
maya.support: customers already filing tickets, I have an open support queue with 12 incidents referencing increased latency + 502s. Should we post to status page now?
lee.oncall: yes, draft below. will wait 10m for vendor update, then post. Draft: "We are investigating increased error rates for text generation requests in us-west1. Some requests may return 502. Engineers are actively investigating. We will update within 60 minutes." Thoughts?
maya.support: short and non-technical is good. add guidance: "If you have workloads in us-west1 consider routing to us-east1 as a workaround."
jamie.prod: +1 to mention workaround. add "no data loss expected" to reassure customers.
lee.oncall: reaching out to cloud provider via their enterprise support channel now (case 246811). pinging vendor contact: @anita.gcp — can you confirm if there's an ongoing internal incident in us-west1 LB?
anita.gcp: thanks for the ping, Anita here. We see a partial backend flapping incident in us-west1 affecting some managed LB pools starting ~12:02 UTC. We're escalating to network team. Case 246811 escalated to S3 priority. I'll post updates here as I have them.
alex.sre: can you share any visibility on whether this is BFD (BGP) or internal fabric? we see conn resets at the OS level.
anita.gcp: initial signal points to a health-signal propagation bug in our LB controller — not BGP. network team reproducing and applying targeted health propagation fix now. ETA unknown, will update in ~15m.
lee.oncall: thanks. action items: 1) post status page in 10m if still degraded (maya) 2) try traffic reroute for Dedicated customers if applicable (alex + sam) 3) hold customer emails minimal until we have vendor confirmation (maya/jamie) 4) provide next update here in 15m.
sam.eng: for Dedicated pools we can add temporary routing rule to prefer us-east1 for new sessions. command to test (internal):
```
# create drift policy to prefer us-east1
redwoodctl route set --pool dedicated-us-west --prefer-region us-east1 --dry-run
```
I'll validate before applying.
lee.oncall: please dry-run and report expected failover time.
sam.eng: dry-run shows config change would take ~45s to propagate to the gateway and new requests would land in us-east1. rolling apply if we need it.
maya.support: prepping status page message and two customer email templates: short notice + follow-up RCA placeholder. Draft status page message (please edit):
"We are currently investigating increased error rates for text generation in the us-west1 region. Some requests may receive 502 errors. If you experience errors, consider retrying or routing requests to us-east1. Our engineering team is working with our cloud provider on a mitigation. We will update within 60 minutes."
jamie.prod: keep it plain language, remove technical details like 502s? customers want to know impact. maybe: "Some requests may fail; we're working on a fix."
maya.support: updated shorter template: "We are aware of errors affecting text generation in us-west1 and are actively investigating. We will provide updates within the hour. Temporary workaround: route traffic to us-east1."
lee.oncall: ok let's hold on posting. Anita — any ETA on LB controller fix?
anita.gcp: network team applied a hotfix to controller at 12:18 UTC for a subset of clusters. We're seeing partial recovery on patched pools. Continuing rollout; will confirm when >=90% pools healthy.
ops-bot: UPDATE — Vendor update recorded for PD#INC-9821 at 12:19 UTC by anita.gcp.
lee.oncall: good progress. sam, prepare to flip routing for the impacted dedicated pools if we don't see >80% healthy by 12:30 UTC.
sam.eng: ready — will coordinate a rolling preference change at 12:33 UTC if needed and post exact command output here before applying.
maya.support: prepping the customer email now. Short version for priority customers:
"We are investigating an issue causing failures for text generation requests in us-west1. Our engineering team is working with our cloud provider to mitigate. Temporary workaround: route to us-east1. We will provide an update within 60 minutes and a follow-up incident report."
jamie.prod: add contact for enterprise customers: support@redwood-inference.example and include dedicated account manager cc.
lee.oncall: patch rollout looks promising — current health is 76% healthy on impacted pools. not quite 80. still seeing intermittent 502s but overall traffic is improving. we should post status page as "degraded performance" and the short customer email.
maya.support: posting now. Status page entry:
```
- Impact: Text generation requests in us-west1 may fail or be slow.
- Current status: Degraded performance. Engineers are investigating with cloud provider.
- Mitigation: Route to us-east1 or retry. Enterprise customers: contact support@redwood-inference.example.
- Next update: in 30 minutes or on progress.
```
posted at 12:27 UTC by maya.support
lee.oncall: thanks. we should also loop in legal/comms for the external messaging template for the follow-up RCA. @jamie.prod please coordinate.
jamie.prod: on it. starting a brief external comms draft and will share in #marketing-review.
anita.gcp: update — rollout to 95% of LB pools complete at 12:31 UTC. error rate trending down. we'll keep monitoring for stabilization window (15m).
ops-bot: EVENT — Vendor indicates mitigation progress for PD#INC-9821 at 12:31 UTC.
lee.oncall: great. sam, hold off on traffic reroute for now. continue to monitor logs and KPIs.
sam.eng: holding. I'll run another verification pass in 10m and confirm.
maya.support: customers notified. already got a handful of confirmations that retrying or switching region fixed immediate issues.
jamie.prod: draft for post-incident customer email (RCA placeholder):
"On 2026-03-15 we experienced increased errors for text generation requests in us-west1 due to a health propagation bug in our cloud provider's load balancer controller. The provider applied a hotfix and we saw recovery starting at 12:31 UTC. Impact window: ~12:02–12:31 UTC. No data loss observed. We will publish a detailed post-incident report with mitigations and follow-up actions."
lee.oncall: perfect. after stabilization, we'll create an internal incident summary and assign RCA owners (network infra + routing + provider liaison).
anita.gcp: confirming final note — we've scheduled a follow-up with our network team to review root cause and improve rollout safeguards. I'll share any postmortem notes we can.
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — error rate returned to baseline at 12:46 UTC according to synthetic checks. PD#INC-9821 closed.
lee.oncall: closing here. next steps: 1) internal postmortem doc (lee, alex, sam) 2) customer RCA email (jamie, maya) 3) follow-up sync with GCP (lee + anita.gcp). I'll kick off the internal doc.
maya.support: filing follow-up tickets for affected customers and queueing the RCA email template for review.
jamie.prod: will draft final external comms and share in #marketing-review.
sam.eng: I'll attach logs and the dry-run outputs to the internal doc.
lee.oncall: thanks everyone. great coordination with vendor. closing thread.
